Filing period: 2025 Q4 (2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31, inclusive).
Filer's business location (origin / place of use): ZIP 78664.

Rules:
1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.
3. Round tax per line to the cent (half-up), then sum.
4. A taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true is exempt (sale for resale) only if
   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a
   missing_exemption_cert fault and the transaction is treated as taxable.
5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

Return figures (sales only for the sales lines):
  gross_sales    = sum of gross_amount of included sales
  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)
  taxable_sales  = gross_sales - exempt_sales
  sales_tax_due  = tax that SHOULD be due on taxable sales per rules 2-3 (not the recorded tax)
  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

Fault codes (report every row that has one; one row may carry several):
  tax_on_exempt_item     - an exempt-category sale with tax recorded
  tax_miscalculated      - a taxable sale whose recorded tax != correct tax (not reported on rows that already
                           carry missing_exemption_cert, and not when nexus_misallocation explains the difference)

  outside_period         - dated outside the filing period (report only this code for that row)
  missing_exemption_cert - per rule 4
  nexus_misallocation    - a taxable sale whose recorded tax equals gross x the ORIGIN (business ZIP) combined rate
                           instead of the destination rate

Filing period: 2025 Q1 (2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31, inclusive).
Filer's business location (origin / place of use): ZIP 78130.

Rules:
1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.
3. Round tax per line to the cent (half-up), then sum.
4. A taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true is exempt (sale for resale) only if
   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a
   missing_exemption_cert fault and the transaction is treated as taxable.
5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

Return figures (sales only for the sales lines):
  gross_sales    = sum of gross_amount of included sales
  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)
  taxable_sales  = gross_sales - exempt_sales
  sales_tax_due  = tax that SHOULD be due on taxable sales per rules 2-3 (not the recorded tax)
  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

Fault codes (report every row that has one; one row may carry several):
  tax_on_exempt_item     - an exempt-category sale with tax recorded

  outside_period         - dated outside the filing period (report only this code for that row)
  missing_exemption_cert - per rule 4
  nexus_misallocation    - a taxable sale whose recorded tax equals gross x the ORIGIN (business ZIP) combined rate
                           instead of the destination rate

1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.

   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a

1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.
3. Round tax per line to the cent (half-up), then sum.

   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a
   missing_exemption_cert fault and the transaction is treated as taxable.
5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

  gross_sales    = sum of gross_amount of included sales
  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)

  sales_tax_due  = tax that SHOULD be due on taxable sales per rules 2-3 (not the recorded tax)
  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

  missing_exemption_cert - per rule 4
  nexus_misallocation    - a taxable sale whose recorded tax equals gross x the ORIGIN (business ZIP) combined rate

Rules:
1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.
3. Round tax per line to the cent (half-up), then sum.
4. A taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true is exempt (sale for resale) only if
   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a
   missing_exemption_cert fault and the transaction is treated as taxable.
5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)

  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.

   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.

   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).

**Scope:** 30 ledger rows. txn_030 is dated 2025-07-14, outside the period, so it is excluded. No invoice numbers repeat, so no duplicate exclusions apply.

**Sales (23 included):**
- Gross sales: $22,632.28
- Exempt sales: $6,886.48. This covers exempt categories plus txn_024, which has a valid resale certificate (RC-83172917), and txn_027, which is a resale claim at or under $200.
- Taxable sales: $15,745.80

**Sales tax due:** I recomputed each taxable sale at its destination combined rate, rounded per line. The per-line total is $1,198.52. Recorded tax is not used for this figure.
- txn_017 (no valid cert, over $200) is treated as taxable at 79401's 6.25%, so it carries $124.66.
- txn_023 and txn_029 were charged at the origin rate (7.75%). Their correct destination tax is $6.97 and $137.21.

**Use tax due:** $177.24. This is txn_026, an apparel purchase with no vendor tax, no valid exemption (no cert, over $200), and so taxable at the filer's ZIP 78130 rate of 7.75%.
- Assumption: I applied rule 4 to this purchase, since it is a taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true and no cert. Rule 4 is worded generally, so I treated it as applying. If rule 4 is meant only for sales, txn_026 would owe no use tax and carry no fault. That would reduce use tax to $0.00 and net remittance to $1,198.52.

**Net remittance:** $1,198.52 + $177.24 = $1,375.76

**Faults:**
- txn_005: exempt consulting sale with $23.43 tax recorded.
- txn_022: exempt consulting sale with $11.79 tax recorded.
- txn_017: claimed exempt with no cert and over $200, so taxable and flagged. Its recorded $0 tax is not separately flagged as miscalculated.
- txn_026: same exemption problem on a purchase.
- txn_023 and txn_029: tax recorded at the origin rate, not the destination rate.
- txn_030: dated outside the filing period.

**Exclusions**
- **Outside period:** txn_001 (2025-11-22), txn_030 (2026-04-06, a purchase), and txn_031 (2026-05-03).
- **Duplicate:** txn_022 repeats INV-3097 from txn_021, so it is excluded as the later occurrence.

**Exempt sales (14,889.92)**
- Exempt categories: txn_003, 021, 026, 028, 029 (9,202.56).
- Valid resale certificates (taxable category, claimed exempt, cert on file): txn_005, 006, 011, 025 (5,687.36).

**Taxable sales**
- Gross sales of included rows: 28,649.34. Taxable sales: 28,649.34 − 14,889.92 = 13,759.42.
- Each taxable line was recomputed at its destination combined rate and rounded per line. All match the recorded tax except txn_015.
- txn_015 recorded 164.42. That equals 2,435.78 × 6.75%, the origin (78664) rate, so it is a nexus_misallocation. The correct destination tax at 7.25% is 176.59, not the 176.62 I first computed.
- Correct sales tax due: 1,061.87.

**Use tax**
- txn_002: furniture bought with no tax charged, 2,296.90 × 6.75% = 155.04.
- txn_023: electronics bought with no tax charged, 2,297.04 × 6.75% = 155.05.
- Total use tax: 310.09. The other purchases either had vendor tax charged or are exempt categories.

**Fault notes**
- txn_003, txn_026, and txn_029 carry tax on exempt categories.
- No missing-certificate cases arose, since every claimed resale exemption has a certificate ID.

</answer>

**Faults on taxable sales:**

- **txn_020:** Recorded $6.10, which equals the 7.25% origin rate ($6.0987). Correct tax at 8.00% is $6.73. This is a nexus misallocation.
- **txn_030:** Tagged as a resale exemption with no certificate and a gross over $200, so it is treated as taxable. Correct tax at 7.75% is $160.90, with none recorded.

**Use tax:**
- **txn_011:** An office supplies purchase over $200 with no vendor tax and no certificate. Treated as taxable at the 7.25% origin rate: $170.19.
- **txn_031:** Software purchase with no vendor tax at 7.25%: $12.60.

**Net remittance:** $780.81 sales tax + $182.79 use tax = $963.60.

Filer's business location (origin / place of use): ZIP 78664.

Rules:
1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.
3. Round tax per line to the cent (half-up), then sum.
4. A taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true is exempt (sale for resale) only if
   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a
   missing_exemption_cert fault and the transaction is treated as taxable.
5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

Return figures (sales only for the sales lines):
  gross_sales    = sum of gross_amount of included sales
  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)
  taxable_sales  = gross_sales - exempt_sales
  sales_tax_due  = tax that SHOULD be due on taxable sales per rules 2-3 (not the recorded tax)
  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

Fault codes (report every row that has one; one row may carry several):
  tax_on_exempt_item     - an exempt-category sale with tax recorded
  tax_miscalculated      - a taxable sale whose recorded tax != correct tax (not reported on rows that already

  outside_period         - dated outside the filing period (report only this code for that row)
  missing_exemption_cert - per rule 4
  nexus_misallocation    - a taxable sale whose recorded tax equals gross x the ORIGIN (business ZIP) combined rate
                           instead of the destination rate

Filing period: 2025 Q4 (2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31, inclusive).
Filer's business location (origin / place of use): ZIP 76102.

Rules:
1. Exempt categories: unprepared_grocery, prescription_drug, medical_device, consulting_service. All other categories are taxable at retail.
2. Sales are destination-sourced: tax = gross_amount x combined rate of the sale's jurisdiction_zip
   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.
3. Round tax per line to the cent (half-up), then sum.
4. A taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true is exempt (sale for resale) only if
   customer_or_vendor_cert_id is non-empty OR gross_amount <= $200.00. Otherwise it is a
   missing_exemption_cert fault and the transaction is treated as taxable.
5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

Return figures (sales only for the sales lines):
  gross_sales    = sum of gross_amount of included sales
  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)
  taxable_sales  = gross_sales - exempt_sales
  sales_tax_due  = tax that SHOULD be due on taxable sales per rules 2-3 (not the recorded tax)
  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

Fault codes (report every row that has one; one row may carry several):
  tax_on_exempt_item     - an exempt-category sale with tax recorded

   (the buyer's delivery ZIP). gross_amount is the pre-tax line amount; tax is added on top.

4. A taxable-category transaction with tax_exempt_claimed=true is exempt (sale for resale) only if

5. Exclude from the return any row dated outside the filing period, and the second (later) occurrence of a
   repeated invoice_number (when dates tie, the later row in the ledger is the duplicate).
6. Purchases: when the vendor charged no tax on a taxable, non-exempt purchase, vendor use tax is due at the
   filer's business ZIP combined rate (per line, rounded). Purchases with vendor-charged tax, exempt categories,
   or a valid resale exemption owe no use tax.

Return figures (sales only for the sales lines):
  gross_sales    = sum of gross_amount of included sales
  exempt_sales   = included sales that are exempt (exempt category, or valid resale per rule 4)
  taxable_sales  = gross_sales - exempt_sales
  sales_tax_due  = tax that SHOULD be due on taxable sales per rules 2-3 (not the recorded tax)
  use_tax_due    = per rule 6
  net_remittance = sales_tax_due + use_tax_due

Fault codes (report every row that has one; one row may carry several):
  tax_on_exempt_item     - an exempt-category sale with tax recorded
  tax_miscalculated      - a taxable sale whose recorded tax != correct tax (not reported on rows that already
                           carry missing_exemption_cert, and not when nexus_misallocation explains the difference)
  duplicate_invoice      - the later occurrence of a repeated invoice_number (report only this code for that row)
  outside_period         - dated outside the filing period (report only this code for that row)
  missing_exemption_cert - per rule 4
  nexus_misallocation    - a taxable sale whose recorded tax equals gross x the ORIGIN (business ZIP) combined rate
                           instead of the destination rate
